**A little update from Lotus Glow Nails**

Dear friends, neighbors, church family, and all my longtime ladies,

Thank you for calling and texting so much! My phone has not stopped ringing, so please pass this letter around in your group texts and emails. Then I can answer everybody one time. 😊

On Sunday, November 8, around 2 a.m., a car came through the front window of Lotus Glow Nails on Bellaire Blvd. Nobody was inside, the driver is okay, and the police came. Her insurance will take care of the damage. I thank God because nobody was hurt.

The front glass is gone, and one pedicure chair is smashed. The car stopped exactly at the pedicure chair, like the lady wanted a spa treatment. My daughter said she got the first drive-thru pedicure in Houston!

The floor looks like a rainbow threw up everywhere. My husband looked at it and said, “Finally, the shop is modern art.” So you see, I have to laugh a little bit. I did cry some in the morning, but I am okay now. Please do not worry about me.

**Right now, the shop is closed.** The city inspector must check the wall before we can open again. The contractor expects us to reopen on **Monday, November 16**. I will send another update if anything changes.

**For this week, Trang, Kim, and I will be working at my cousin Hoa’s salon, Pearland Nail Bar.** If you need your nails done or want to make an appointment, please **call or text my cell at 832-555-0147**. We will take care of you there.

Also, your **Lotus Glow Nails gift cards are still good**. Nobody will lose their money. After 11 years, you know I am not going anywhere—just temporarily waiting for a new window and one pedicure chair!

Thank you for all your messages, prayers, and food. Mrs. Dung even brought me pho this morning. I am very lucky to have so many good people around me.

Please share this with anybody who is asking, and come see us in Pearland this week. Save your worries—just bring your hands and feet!

With love and thanks,  
**Your nail lady at Lotus Glow Nails**
